Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: WeNeed is an app for shared lists: shopping, tasks and checklists for every place. This page explains what information is stored, why, and what you can do about it.

collect.title: What is stored
collect.body: Your name and email address, from your Google account or the email you signed in with. Also what you put in the app: places, lists, items, notes and attachments, and who added or checked each item.

use.title: Why
use.body: Only to make the app work: to recognize you when you sign in and to show your lists to the people you share them with. The information isn't sold, isn't used for advertising and isn't passed to anyone else.

services.title: Outside services
services.body: Google is used for signing in with a Google account. Resend sends sign-in codes and invites by email. Vercel runs the site and stores attached files, and Neon stores the data, on servers in Europe (Frankfurt). Messages you write in a list's AI chat are sent to Anthropic's Claude to turn them into list items.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: One cookie keeps you signed in, one remembers which place you chose, and one remembers your language. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

demo.title: The demo
demo.body: The demo needs no sign-up. Its lists are kept only in your browser and are not sent to us. Messages you write to the demo's AI chat are sent to Claude to understand them, and are not stored. To limit the number of messages, only a hashed value derived from your IP address is kept, never the address itself.

delete.title: Deleting information
delete.body: You can ask at any time to see or delete your account and all your information by writing to the email below. Deletion is done within 30 days.
